messages.text:
You do need a laptop stand and stand alone keyboard and mouse. I disagree with it only being for stand-up desks. The laptop is not well ergonomically designed. Your wrists need to be raised. The screen should be at eye level. The laptop doesn't really help with that. 

The first option looks like a gimmick, but could be useful.
